title: MY DAD IS DESTROYING MY SCHOOL! 🏗️
topic: Family betrayal and school demolition conspiracy

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: DAD, EXPLAIN WHY YOUR NAME IS ON A PAPER THAT TURNS MY ENTIRE SCHOOL INTO A LUXURY PARKING LOT!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Nix, keep your voice down [beat] you don't understand how the city planning department works behind closed doors for people like us.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Oh, he understands perfectly, Rafiq [beat] your son found the one document that proves you're the one funding the entire eviction project.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You told me you were working late to save our mortgage [beat] but you were actually plotting to bulldoze my friends' futures for a paycheck?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: It wasn't my choice, Nix [beat] the bank told me if I didn't sign that permit, we would lose this house by the end of the month!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: So you traded our school for our house? [beat] Dad, that's low, even for a real estate lawyer trying to make a desperate end-of-year quota.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: There is a way to make this entire mess disappear, but it requires Nix to hand over the flash drive he stole from my office.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, if Dad signed it, why are YOU so desperate to get the files back? [beat] What else is hidden in those folders, Principal Huda?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That's none of your concern, you little brat [beat] just hand over the drive before I call the police for trespassing and theft.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nobody is calling anyone until I see page forty-two [beat] Rafiq, is there another signature next to yours on the original draft of the permit?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Don't look at the back of the page, Nix [beat] there's a reason I never wanted you to find these files in the first place.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Too late, I'm looking right now [beat] Wait... why is Principal Huda's sister listed as the primary contractor for the new construction?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: GIVE ME THAT PAPER RIGHT NOW OR YOU'LL NEVER SET FOOT IN ANY SCHOOL IN THIS COUNTY EVER AGAIN!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The demolition starts in twelve hours [beat] and the only person who can stop it is currently being cornered in his own living room.
